column3: Close to the Hebrew; “to the wilderness” is supplied with “to,” and “the ruler of the land” is read as recipient.
Close to the Hebrew; “a fluttering bird, a nest sent away” is rendered “a wandering bird thrown out of the nest.”
Close to the Hebrew; “do not expose” is rendered “Do not betray.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the trampler” is rendered “The oppressors.”
Close to the Hebrew; בַּחֶסֶד (hesed) is rendered “In mercy,” and NKJV capitalizes “One,” and “tent” “tabernacle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “arrogance” is rendered “wrath,” and “his empty boasts are not right” “his lies shall not be so.”
Close to the Hebrew; לַאֲשִׁישֵׁי (“raisin-cakes”) is rendered “For the foundations of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “choice grapes” is rendered “choice plants.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shouting” is rendered “battle cries.”
Close to the Hebrew; “orchard” is rendered “plentiful field.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my inward parts” is rendered “my heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “presents itself” is rendered “it is seen.”
Close to the Hebrew; “little smallness, not mighty” is rendered “very small and feeble.”
